title: Canonical constant-module realization on the small etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $A$ be a commutative ring in the coefficient universe. Let $A_T$ be the constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and $U(A_T)$ its underlying ring sheaf. Define the functor $R_{T,A}$ from ordinary $A$-module-valued sheaves to sheaves of $U(A_T)$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by composing the canonical constant-scalar realization [def-pur-etale-constant-scalar-realization] with restriction of scalars along the inverse of the canonical comparison from the constant ring sheaf to $U(A_T)$ [def-sfb-constant-module-coefficient-transport]. On objects and maps this retains the underlying abelian sheaf and changes only its scalar coordinates by that canonical ring isomorphism. Define $R^\bullet_{T,A}$ on integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] by applying $R_{T,A}$ in each degree and to each differential and chain-map component. No flatness, K-flatness, boundedness, finiteness or nonempty-scheme hypothesis is imposed.

def etaleSumFlatModuleRealization (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] :
    Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A)))
